main_text.p: tificum, ad observanda statuta, privi-legia, consuetudines, & libertates illius communitatis. Quaeritur, Quali est obligatio? Respondeo, Imprimis, Juratus obligatur ad omnia statuta fundamentalia, quantum in ipso est, simpliciter observanda. Fundamentalia autem dico, quae necessario & proximè tendunt ad conservandum publicum statum, ordinem, & honorem totius corporis sive communitatis. Sed id fecundo non semper & necessario ad rigorem literae; sed prout in more posita sunt & usu communi recepta, & prout approbatâ consuetudine ab aliis observantur. Tertio ad minorum gentium statuta quod attinet, quae pertinent ad externam tantum formam & decus; vel quae Iuramentum non debet plus obligare quā voluerit, aut rationi biliter vel le debuerit obligare ordinator talis juramenti. Gerson. de ult. spiritu. cit. le&t.4. aut ex conditione materiae, aut ex forma sanctionis, aut alio probabili indicio vir prudens judicaret non fuisse consideratum cum intentione {1}rigidae obligatio-nis; obligatur ea ordinariè observare, sic tamen ut liceat ei quandoque justa de causa sine scrupulo conscientiae praetermittere quod statuto aliquo faciendum praescribitur; modò id fiat citra scandalum aut contemptum. Quarto Obligatio extenditur & ad statuta de fu-turc

page.notes: Right edge of the scan cuts the text column; the last letters of several lines are lost, so some words are reconstructed from context: "privi-legia", "justa", "fecundo" (line-end hyphen not clearly visible), "sine scrupulo conscientiae" and the cut-off word endings are uncertain. The superscript "1" before "rigidae" is a reference mark with no matching note on the page, so it is marked {1}. The left margin note is a single block of several lines, placed where it begins; its hyphenation and the words "ordinator talis juramenti" and "spiritu" are doubtful. The "le&t.4." mark is partly cut. "tumnon" in the margin is printed without a space and is kept as printed; its reading was taken as "Juramentum non..." with hyphenation. The word "Quali" is printed as such.
